questions.topic: A numeric string in an arithmetic expression
questions.learningObjective: Avoid plus coercion bugs in sums
questions.stem: Explain the safest way to sum two values from text inputs.

answer.exemplar: Convert both values with Number or parseFloat before using plus, and validate they are non-empty first.

questions.explanation: Explicit conversion prevents concatenation. The tempting direct plus produces string results.
